seeds: I'm Kim Min-jun. My father Kim Sang-ho runs a pharmacy in Daegu. My mother, Lee Hye-jin, passed away on 2019-11-03.
I have two siblings: my older sister Kim Ji-woo, born 21 April 1982, and my younger brother Kim Tae-yang, born on 1990-07-30.
My wife is Park Seo-yeon; we married on 11 October 2014. Her father, Park Jong-su, lives with us in Seoul.
Our son Kim Do-yun arrived on March 9, 2019.
Tae-yang's wife, Choi Yu-na, is expecting their first baby in spring.
Kim Ji-ho is my business partner at the café. We are not related.
My cousin Lee Joon-ho, my mother's nephew, lives in Busan.
I bought the café building in Mapo-gu on 5 January 2017. My father gave me a plot of farmland near Andong in 2021.
We sold our old apartment in Suwon in 2020 and now rent a flat in Seoul.
